channel.title: IT services · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on IT services in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.3).

item.title: [−1] Fed holds at 3.75–4.00% in a 10–2 vote; two officials wanted a hike
item.description:
The chair said inflation is still elevated and declined to signal the next move; markets read hints of a December hike. As expected yesterday, but the dissents are new. Ongoing tightening bias.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — US demand uncertainty

Why it matters: A hawkish hold keeps US yields and the dollar firm, sustaining pressure on the rupee, G-Secs and foreign flows into India.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Foreign investor flows −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Rupee falls 21 paise to 95.28 per dollar on a firmer dollar and higher crude
item.description:
It opened at 95.01 and touched 95.29. Reverses Tuesday's small gain. Pressure persists near record lows.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Export earnings

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises imported oil and input costs and adds to inflation, while helping exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days
